reasons.detail: R1 — Resolution flow now performs active profile prefix lookup, then default profile fallback, then default provider fallback when no explicit provider/profile override is provided, via resolveProfileSelection + resolveProviderOverrideKey.

R2 — Explicit override handling remains highest-priority through resolveProviderOverrideKey on the selected key, and tests assert plugin-level provider/profile overrides are forwarded and win over active/default routing.

R3 — Default alias normalization was added (codex→codex/gpt-5.4, claude→claude/sonnet) before registry lookup, and unknown defaults are not remapped so unresolved keys fail rather than fallback elsewhere.
R4 — Agent.call now throws attempt.formatFailure(), which includes commandId, provider override, profile source, active profile, default key, selected/lookup keys, and an explicit reason.
R5 — The failure path now emits only structured resolution metadata and omits prompt/system text and provider argument/secrets content; it also does not include absolute config paths.

R6 — Core docs/flow routing behavior remains via existing profile-prefix + default-profile fallback logic; added coverage checks preserve docs/flow precedence with only diagnostic text changed for unresolved cases.

R7 — New regression tests were added for plugin fallback, active profile miss, default profile fallback, explicit plugin override precedence, built-in default family mapping, unknown/default-lookup failures, and redacted diagnostics.
